tasks.label: inspect-rectax-frontend
args: cd /mnt/d/WSL2/AI/RecTax; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}' | grep rectax-frontend || true && docker exec rectax-frontend nginx -v 2>&1 || true && docker top rectax-frontend || true

tasks.label: inspect-rectax-paddle-ocr
args: cd /mnt/d/WSL2/AI/RecTax; docker ps -a --filter name=rectax-paddle-ocr --format 'table {{.Names}}	{{.Status}}	{{.Image}}' && echo '---' && docker logs --tail=200 rectax-paddle-ocr 2>&1 | tail -n 120

tasks.label: verify-paddle-cache-mount
args: cd /mnt/d/WSL2/AI/RecTax; set -e; HOST_DIR='/mnt/d/WSL2/AI/RecTax/paddle-model-cache'; CTN_DIR='/root/.paddleocr'; echo '=== host count ==='; find "$HOST_DIR" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l; echo '=== container count ==='; docker exec rectax-paddle-ocr sh -lc 'find "'"'"'$CTN_DIR'"'"'" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l'; echo '=== sample(host) ==='; find "$HOST_DIR" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 5; echo '=== sample(container) ==='; docker exec rectax-paddle-ocr sh -lc 'find "'"'"'$CTN_DIR'"'"'" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 5'

tasks.label: rectax-health-snapshot
args: cd /mnt/d/WSL2/AI/RecTax; echo '=== compose ps ==='; docker compose ps; echo '=== backend health ==='; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health || true; echo; echo '=== paddle health ==='; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8011/health || true; echo; echo '=== frontend head ==='; curl -I -sS http://127.0.0.1:8080 | head -n 1 || true

tasks.label: rectax-health-check-all
args: cd /mnt/d/WSL2/AI/RecTax; set -e; FAIL=0; check_json(){ NAME="$1"; URL="$2"; if curl -fsS "$URL" >/dev/null; then echo "[OK] $NAME $URL"; else echo "[FAIL] $NAME $URL"; FAIL=1; fi; }; check_head(){ NAME="$1"; URL="$2"; if curl -fsSI "$URL" >/dev/null; then echo "[OK] $NAME $URL"; else echo "[FAIL] $NAME $URL"; FAIL=1; fi; }; echo '=== compose ps ==='; docker compose --env-file .env ps || true; echo '=== health checks ==='; check_json backend http://127.0.0.1:8000/health; check_json paddle-ocr-v3 http://127.0.0.1:8011/health; check_json paddle-ocr-v4 http://127.0.0.1:8012/health; check_head frontend http://127.0.0.1:8080; exit $FAIL

tasks.label: ocr-compare-last-upload
args: cd /mnt/d/WSL2/AI/RecTax; echo '=== v3 ==='; curl -sS -X POST -F "file=@uploads/IMG20260328145126.jpg" http://127.0.0.1:8011/ocr/; echo; echo '=== v4 ==='; curl -sS -X POST -F "file=@uploads/IMG20260328145126.jpg" http://127.0.0.1:8012/ocr/; echo
